The topology_boundary_auditor shows a clean mask (0.99 confidence), suggesting the overall shape is coherent, but this does not rule out internal anatomical ambiguity or edge softness. The perceptual_quality_auditor notes 'darken' which is stylistic, not an artifact. I agree with the Router's severity ratings; the paw ambiguity is a notable defect in an AI generation, preventing a perfect score.
